preview.title: Your week
preview.subtitle: Here’s a preview of your plan.
preview.invalid: Some answers aren’t valid: go back and check them.
preview.minaA11y: Mina celebrates: your week is ready
preview.range: From {from} to {to}. You can change any meal whenever you like.
welcome.resume: Pick up where you left off
welcome.minaA11y: Mina, your little shopping bag, waving hello
welcome.subscription: Personalise your plan. Full access requires a subscription.
welcome.chefA11y: Mina Chef with a wooden spoon
welcome.recipesText: Easy recipes, picked for your taste.
welcome.shoppingText: One list for each day you go shopping.
intro.a11y: Welcome to Mina! Tap to skip.
people.title: How many people usually eat?
people.tip: Hi, I’m Mina! Give me two minutes and I’ll plan your week.
people.note: Recipes and shopping will use this number. You can change it for a single meal.
meals.title: Which meals do you want to plan?
meals.subtitle: You can pick more than one.
diet.title: How do you eat?
diet.howLabel: How do I decide what fits?
diet.howText: Pescatarian: no meat, but fish is fine. Compatibility is worked out from each recipe’s ingredients.
exclusions.title: Any ingredients to avoid?
exclusions.subtitle: Allergies, intolerances or personal choices: they’ll always be left out.
exclusions.react: Got it: these ingredients will never show up in the recipes I suggest.
exclusions.brandNote: With an exclusion on, Mina also skips recipes with packaged products whose allergens depend on the brand (e.g. pesto, bread).
dislikes.title: Anything you don’t like?
dislikes.subtitle: You won’t see it in the recipes I suggest.
dislikes.react: No problem: I’ll use other ingredients to keep things varied.
portions.title: How do you usually eat?
portions.subtitle: It just helps me suggest amounts close to your habits.
portions.tip: No diets: I only use these answers so you don’t cook too much or too little.
portions.goal: What kind of meals do you prefer?
portions.note: Not used for any calculation. Mina is not a nutrition service.
portions.disclaimer: Portions are approximate and based on the habits you set in the app.
goal.proteici: More meat, fish, eggs or legumes
quantities.title: Your usual amounts
quantities.subtitle: Recipes and shopping will use these values as a base.
quantities.tip: If you usually cook 70 g of pasta, I’ll use 70 g. Simple.
quantities.howLabel: How do I use these amounts?
quantities.example: Example: with {grams} g of pasta, a tuna pasta for 2 people uses {total} g, and the shopping list adjusts.
tastes.title: Your tastes
tastes.subtitle: Choose freely: you can combine several preferences.
tastes.tip: Tell me what you like and I’ll suggest it more often, while keeping things varied.
tastes.likes: What do you most enjoy eating?
tastes.week: What kind of week do you want?
tastes.howLabel: How do I use your tastes?
tastes.howText: Your tastes give some recipes priority but don’t rule out the others; your food exclusions are always respected. “{style}” doesn’t estimate prices: it favours recipes that share ingredients.
like.proteiche: With meat, fish, eggs, legumes or tofu
weekStyle.proteica: More meat, fish, eggs or legumes
time.title: How much time do you have to cook?
time.subtitle: For each main meal.
times.title: What time do you usually eat?
times.subtitle: Used for reminders. Rough times are fine.
frequency.title: How many times a week do you shop?
frequency.note: Times a week. Next, I’ll suggest the days: you can change them.
shoppingDays.title: Which days do you go shopping?
shoppingDays.tip: I’ll split your shopping across these days, so fresh food stays fresh.
shoppingDays.chosen_one: You picked {count} day: we’ll use that one.
shoppingDays.chosen_other: You picked {count} days: we’ll use these.
shoppingDays.howLabel: How do I split the shopping?
shoppingDays.howText: Each item goes on the last shopping trip before it’s needed, taking into account how long it keeps.
budget.title: How much do you want to spend on shopping?
budget.subtitle: Optional: it helps pick recipes that reuse ingredients.
budget.tip: Eat well, your way, without buying more than you need.
budget.question: Should Mina take your budget into account?
budget.mode.minimo: Yes, I want to spend as little as possible
budget.mode.equilibrato: Yes, I want a balanced budget
budget.mode.limite: Yes, I have a set limit
budget.mode.off: No, just go by my tastes
budget.howMuch: How much would you like to spend?
budget.invalid: Enter a valid amount, e.g. 60 or 60.50.
budget.scopeMeals_one: The meals I plan here ({count} person)
budget.scopeMeals_other: The meals I plan here ({count} people)
budget.howLabel: How do I use the budget?
budget.howText: The quick amounts are just shortcuts, not recommended sums. Mina never cuts meals or portions to stay on budget: it picks recipes that reuse ingredients and need fewer purchases. Costs in euros only appear for products whose price you know (Profile → Prices).
equipment.title: What do you have in your kitchen?
equipment.note: I’ll only suggest recipes you can make with these.
pantry.title: What do you already have at home?
pantry.subtitle: Optional: it helps you buy only what you need.
pantry.note: Only pick what you have. A rough amount is enough: you can fix it later in the Pantry.
notifications.title: Would you like reminders?
notifications.subtitle: An alert when it’s time to start cooking and on shopping days. No spam: only what you choose here.
notifications.tip: I’ll only message you when it matters: no spam, promise.
notifications.leadNote: The alert comes at meal time, minus the recipe’s duration and the extra lead time.
